sentence: Hannah Brightwell is the social worker from children's services and chairs the meeting.
The meeting is a child in need review for the Haddon family, held on Tuesday, 24 November.
The family includes Leanne (mother), Tyler (eight years old, Year Four at Millbrook Primary), and baby Amelia (seven months).
Leanne has apologised for not being present at the meeting.
Amelia has a GP appointment this morning and Leanne rang the social worker first.
Leanne has stated she is happy for information to be shared among professionals but does not want anything passed on to her mother, Sandra.
Tyler's attendance is currently 84% (this term), previously reported as 78% (last year), with most absences being lates, especially on Mondays.
Tyler has mentioned to staff that he needs to prepare Amelia's bottles in the morning before coming to school, which raises concerns about him being a young carer.
There have been no disclosures from Tyler regarding hunger, clothing, hygiene, or injuries; no marks or injuries have been reported.
Tyler has had a few meltdowns at lunchtime, and staff have raised concerns about possible ADHD or CAMHS involvement.
There has been no formal referral for ADHD or CAMHS services; the concern has only been discussed in staff meetings.
A lunchtime supervisor reported that Jordan (Amelia's father, ex-partner) has dropped Tyler off at the gate on a few mornings.
Jordan's presence at the school has not been independently verified; it is reported by a third party and not seen by school staff.
Amelia is growing well, tracking at the 25th centile, with no faltering growth or weight concerns.
Amelia has a cow's milk protein allergy and is on hypoallergenic formula, which is progressing well.
Amelia has had a cough for about three weeks and sleeps in the back bedroom, which has black mould on the wall behind the cot.
Health visitor Ruth Lindqvist sees Amelia fortnightly; visits would increase to weekly if weight drops or cough worsens.
Leanne scored high on the PHQ (Patient Health Questionnaire) for depression, indicating low mood.
Sandra (Leanne's mother) contacted Ruth Lindqvist last Wednesday and reported that Leanne has stopped taking sertraline.
Ruth has not confirmed with Leanne or the GP whether Leanne has stopped taking sertraline.
Ruth did not disclose any information to Sandra and only listened and thanked her when she spoke.
The surveyor will assess the property for potential category one hazard; if found, a management move or decanting may be considered, but this is conditional on the surveyor's find.
The surveyor's findings will determine whether repairs or action are needed; no fixed date for repairs is available.
The flat at 22 Ashby Court has damp issues originating from the external wall, not from washing or window conditions; the wall is wet to the touch.
Leanne has stated she does not want her mother Sandra involved in any way, and the health visitor has confirmed this.
The suggestion to move Amelia's cot to the front bedroom with Leanne was made, and Leanne has said she would try to do so; this will be checked during the next visit.
The rent account for the flat is clear with no arrears.
The tenancy is an introductory tenancy and is due for review on 11 January.
S3 states that Tyler's mother is attentive with Amelia and that she is lovely with Amelia.
S2 states that Tyler adores his mother and talks about his mum all the time.
S2 proposes offering Tyler a free breakfast club every day, with doors opening at eight, starting Monday the thirtieth.
S3 confirms that the breakfast club would help with late arrivals.
S2 states that Tyler would be fed as part of the breakfast club.
S1 mentions having raised the breakfast club idea with Leanne on Thursday, and Leanne is keen to support it.
S2 suggests that Tyler's mother would benefit from a parenting course offered by the Family Hub on Wednesdays.
S1 states that she raised the parenting course with the mother, who declined it, saying she felt 'being told she's a bad mum'.
S1 notes that the mother expressed interest in the stay and play at the Family Hub for Amelia to meet other mums.
S3 confirms she can refer the mother and Amelia to the stay and play via an online form.
S1 states that she will speak to Leanne about the morning routine and whether a young carers assessment is appropriate for Tyler's bottle use.
S3 asks whether Tyler is making up formula, noting that the hypoallergenic formula is fiddly.
S2 states that he does not know whether Tyler is making up formula, only that he said 'bottles'.
S3 says she will ask Leanne about the formula situation.
S1 states that the case will remain classified as child in need, noting that Gareth disagrees and believes it should go to conference.
S2 agrees that the case should remain as child in need, acknowledging the disagreement.
S1 states that the CAMHS issue has not been agreed upon and will be discussed at the next review.
S3 confirms that the move to Sandra's is not happening.
S1 confirms that the move to Sandra's is not a decision and is not agreed.
S4 confirms that the management move is Darren's if dependent on the survey, and nothing is agreed on it.
S3 states that they are on leave the entire week of the eighth, so the review cannot be on that day.
S1 confirms that Tyler will start the breakfast club on Monday the thirtieth.
S1 confirms that Ruth will make a perinatal referral by Friday.
S3 confirms that the perinatal referral will be made by Friday.
S1 confirms that Ruth will refer Leanne and Amelia to the stay and play by Friday the fourth.
S3 confirms that the stay and play referral will be made by Friday the fourth.
S1 proposes the next review be on Tuesday the eighteenth of December at ten o'clock at school.
A perinatal mental health referral is to be made by Ruth Lindqvist, scheduled for Friday, 27 November.
A housing surveyor is to visit the flat at 22 Ashby Court on Tuesday, 1 December, to assess damp and potential hazards.
S4 (Darren Achebe) will conduct a survey on Tuesday the first and send a report to S1 within a week of the visit.
S2 will provide S1 with an attendance breakdown by Friday, broken down by day.
S1 will speak to her manager about the Jordan information and Clare's Law question and email everyone by Monday the thirtieth.
